paragraphs: SkyfireAI describes itself as the foundation for multi-ship Drone First Responder (DFR) programs. Its DFR offering aims to put a drone on scene first when seconds matter, giving teams instant situational awareness. The company lists police, fire, EMS, tactical ops, ISR, utilities, logistics and private security as the groups it serves.

Beyond DFR, its service lines include Disaster Response Services, Automation & AI, Private Security & Overwatch, UAS and cUAS R&D, and OEM & Specialty Training. SkyfireAI lists headquarters in Huntsville, Alabama (Rocket City HQ) and Hope, Maine (New England HQ).
